modelName: S29 — Empirical-Bayes anchored hybrid pricing model
prediction: Empirical-Bayes cell anchor (log-space shrinkage toward S28 surface) + cut-stratified anchoring (Tier A/B) + support-shrunk monotone LightGBM residual

architecture.anchor: Empirical-Bayes cell OFFSET from surface: offset = (n*mean_residual + k*0)/(n+k), shrunk toward zero as support thins
architecture.surface: S28-fixed monotone parametric surface — always active, anchors are additive offsets
architecture.cutStratification: Tier A (ID/EX, EX/VG polish+symmetry) vs Tier B (commodity), offsets per tier
architecture.residual: Monotone LightGBM on log(actual/(surface+offset)), shrunk by min(1, n/10)
architecture.displayBoundary: PAV/isotonic projection reserved for display layer only

data.holdoutMethod: cell-hash-based (whole cells held out, not rows)
